title: #185 Employers and Employees
prompt: Some employers take the opinions of their employees when determining the areas to invest in. Please explain whether it will bring advantages or disadvantages.

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main advantage of employers asking for employee opinions is that it helps the company make better products.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main advantage of employers asking for employee opinions is that it helps the company make better products.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The main disadvantage is that the process of collecting and reviewing many ideas takes up a lot of time for the bosses.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main disadvantage is that the process of collecting and reviewing many ideas takes up a lot of time for the bosses.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Employee ideas can help a company improve its products and grow.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Employee ideas can help a company improve its products and grow.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Managers might ignore suggestions, which creates a negative risk for the company.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Managers might ignore suggestions, which creates a negative risk for the company.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Involving employees in decisions can boost company morale and improve employee engagement.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Involving employees in decisions can boost company morale and improve employee engagement.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Relying on employee opinions can create a disadvantage because staff may lack the necessary financial knowledge for big decisions.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Relying on employee opinions can create a disadvantage because staff may lack the necessary financial knowledge for big decisions.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Involving workers in spending decisions can help improve the company's overall performance.

angles.label: Point 2

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
